### [203] [Towards Fewer Control Laws via Continuous-Time Multiparametric Programming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21031)
*Lida Lamakani,Efstratios N. Pistikopoulos*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于连续时间模型的多参数规划框架，直接应用庞特里亚金最大值原理，无需离散化即可将最优控制律表达为初始状态的显式函数，相比传统离散时间方法大幅减少了临界区域数量，并显式给出切换时间以降低在线计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统离散时间多参数最优控制面临精度与计算复杂度之间的权衡：离散区间过少无法准确刻画系统动态，过多则导致决策变量和临界区域数量爆炸性增长，使得离线求解和在线查询成本高昂。

Method: 直接在连续时间框架下应用庞特里亚金最大值原理，避免模型离散化，将最优控制律恢复为初始状态的显式函数；同时将切换时间也表达为初始状态的显式函数，使得在线控制器可预知控制结构变化时刻。

Result: 连续时间方法产生的临界区域数量远少于离散时间方法，且该数量固定不变（仅取决于问题本身结构而非离散化网格）；在PAROC框架案例研究中验证了该方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 连续时间多参数规划是传统离散时间方法的严谨替代方案，能显著降低离线与在线计算成本，且切换时间的显式表达进一步减少了在线执行开销。

Abstract: Multiparametric programming offers a powerful solution to the computational burden of solving optimal control problems repeatedly online. By solving the problem once offline, it yields the optimal control laws as explicit closed-form functions of the initial system state, reducing online execution to a direct evaluation with no iterations required. Most existing works build this idea on a discrete-time foundation, slicing the time horizon into intervals and applying KKT conditions to the resulting algebraic system. This discretization forces a tradeoff: too few intervals and the model fails to capture the true system dynamics, while too many cause the problem size, the number of decision variables, and the number of critical regions to grow rapidly, making both offline preparation and online lookup increasingly expensive. This work develops a multiparametric framework that works directly with the continuous-time problem. Pontryagin's Maximum Principle (PMP) is applied without any model discretization, and the optimal control is recovered as an explicit function of the initial state. Compared to the discrete-time formulation, the continuous-time approach produces substantially fewer critical regions, and this number remains fixed regardless of accuracy requirements, since it reflects the structure of the problem itself rather than a discretization grid. The framework also yields the switching times as explicit functions of the initial state, directly exposing when and how the optimal control structure changes over the horizon. Knowing these switching times in advance allows the real-time controller to skip unnecessary computations between them, further reducing the online execution cost. Results from a PAROC framework case study demonstrate that the continuous-time multiparametric approach is a rigorous alternative to the conventional discrete-time formulations.

</details>


### [204] [DUET: Decentralized Bilevel Optimization without Lower-Level Strong Convexity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21153)
*Zhen Qin,Zhuqing Liu,Songtao Lu,Yingbin Liang,Jia Liu*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出DUET算法，通过引入递减二次正则化消除对下层强凸性的依赖，首次在去中心化场景下实现无需下层强凸性的双层优化，并利用梯度追踪处理数据异质性，取得了$O(1/T^{1-5p-\frac{11}{4}τ})$的迭代复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有去中心化双层优化方法大多依赖下层强凸性假设来保证唯一解和良定义的超梯度，这限制了其在许多不满足该假设的实际场景中的应用。

Method: 提出单循环DUET算法：在下层目标中引入递减二次正则化，消除对下层强凸性的依赖；结合梯度追踪技术处理数据异质性；采用控制参数$p$和$τ$分别调节下层学习率和平均化。

Result: DUET在宽松假设下实现了$O(1/T^{1-5p-\frac{11}{4}τ})$的近似KKT驻点收敛迭代复杂度；数值实验验证了理论发现和实际有效性。

Conclusion: 这是首个在去中心化且存在数据异质性的场景下解决无需下层强凸性的双层优化问题的工作，拓展了DBO方法的适用范围。

Abstract: Decentralized bilevel optimization (DBO) provides a powerful framework for multi-agent systems to solve local bilevel tasks in a decentralized fashion without the need for a central server. However, most existing DBO methods rely on lower-level strong convexity (LLSC) to guarantee unique solutions and a well-defined hypergradient for stationarity measure, hindering their applicability in many practical scenarios not satisfying LLSC. To overcome this limitation, we introduce a new single-loop DBO algorithm called diminishing quadratically-regularized bilevel decentralized optimization (DUET), which eliminates the need for LLSC by introducing a diminishing quadratic regularization to the lower-level (LL) objective. We show that DUET achieves an iteration complexity of $O(1/T^{1-5p-\frac{11}{4}τ})$ for approximate KKT-stationary point convergence under relaxed assumptions, where $p$ and $τ$ are control parameters for LL learning rate and averaging, respectively. In addition, our DUET algorithm incorporates gradient tracking to address data heterogeneity, a key challenge in DBO settings. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to tackle DBO without LLSC under decentralized settings with data heterogeneity. Numerical experiments validate the theoretical findings and demonstrate the practical effectiveness of our proposed algorithms.

</details>


### [205] [A Multi-Objective Approach to Curriculum-Based Course Timetabling with Continuity Across Semesters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21176)
*Florian Meier,Thomas Stidsen,Clemens Thielen,Andreas Wiese*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文针对大学课程时间表编排问题，提出了一种多目标混合整数规划方法，平衡教师与学生两大利益相关者的偏好，同时通过限制课程时间分配的变动次数（扰动）来保持课表在学年之间的连续性。基于词典序ε约束法探索帕累托前沿，并在慕尼黑工业大学施特劳宾校区的真实数据上验证了方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单目标或加权求和的方法会模糊不同利益相关者偏好之间的内在权衡，无法透明地揭示教师目标与学生目标之间的冲突关系。

Method: 建立多目标混合整数规划模型，分别建模教师和学生目标，引入扰动数量约束来保持课表连续性；采用基于词典序ε约束法的多目标求解策略，计算一组覆盖目标空间不同区域的代表性解集。

Result: 在真实数据上验证发现：教师与学生目标之间存在明确且一致的权衡关系；允许的扰动数量是关键决策参数，适当放宽可显著提升双方课表质量，但存在边际递减效应。

Conclusion: 该方法能够生成多样化的优化课表，为实际排课提供决策支持，实现利益相关者权衡与课表连续性的透明分析。

Abstract: We study a curriculum-based university course timetabling problem in which the preferences of two key stakeholder groups - lecturers and students - must be balanced while maintaining continuity across semesters in a weekly repeating timetable. While existing approaches typically rely on single-objective formulations or aggregate multiple objectives into a weighted sum, this can obscure the underlying trade-offs between conflicting stakeholder preferences. We therefore propose a multi-objective mixed-integer programming approach that explicitly separates lecturer and student objectives and incorporates timetable continuity by limiting the number of changes, called perturbations, in the time period assignments of selected courses relative to the corresponding semester of the previous academic year. To explore the resulting trade-offs, we develop a multi-objective solution approach based on the lexicographic $\varepsilon$-constraint method, enabling the computation of a representative set of solutions whose images, i.e., their vectors of objective values, cover different regions of the objective space.
  The approach is evaluated on real-world instances from the Straubing Campus of the Technical University of Munich. The computational results reveal a clear and consistent trade-off between lecturers' and students' objectives across all instances. Moreover, the number of allowed perturbations is identified as a key decision parameter: relaxing this constraint significantly improves timetable quality for both stakeholder groups, although diminishing returns are observed beyond certain thresholds.
  Overall, the proposed approach provides decision support by generating a diverse set of optimized timetables and enabling a transparent analysis of stakeholder trade-offs and continuity for the practical timetable planning process.

</details>


### [206] [Restart and Adaptive Acceleration in Stochastic Gradient Methods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21354)
*Ali Elhishi,Chistophe Roux,Alexandre d'Aspremont*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究了非光滑弱凸随机优化问题中的重启策略，利用Kurdyka-Łojasiewicz不等式实现加速收敛，并证明重启方案对KŁ指数误设具有鲁棒性，在玩具问题和LLM训练上进行了实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在非光滑弱凸随机优化中，KŁ不等式虽能刻画局部几何结构，但如何利用重启策略系统性地加速收敛尚不清楚，且KŁ指数等正则性常数在实践中难以获取，亟需自适应的加速方案。

Method: 理论分析：推导重启策略在KŁ不等式下的收敛率，建立加速与KŁ指数的显式依赖关系；证明最优重启调度等价于Polyak步长的学习率；给出对KŁ指数误设的鲁棒性定理。实验：在可控KŁ指数的玩具问题以及大规模LLM训练上验证方法有效性。

Result: 重启策略实现了依赖于KŁ指数的加速收敛；最优重启调度与Polyak步长学习率等价；重启方案对KŁ指数显著误设仍保持近自适应性能；在LLM训练中验证了实际有效性。

Conclusion: 重启策略是解决非光滑弱凸随机优化中KŁ不等式加速问题的有效且鲁棒的方法，同时具有理论保证和实际可用性，为自适应优化算法设计提供了新思路。

Abstract: We study restart schemes in stochastic optimization problems for non-smooth and weakly convex that satisfy a Kurdyka-Łojasiewicz inequality. We show that using restarts allows us to leverage the KŁ inequalities to achieve improved rates of convergence, with acceleration depending explicitly on the KŁ exponent. Furthermore, optimal restart schedules lead to learning-rates akin to Polyak steps for SGD. While regularity constants such as the KŁ exponent are typically unknown in practice, we prove that restart schemes are robust to a significant misspecification of these constants, hence nearly adaptive. We detail numerical experiments on both toy problems, where the KŁ exponent is controlled, and training of Large Language Models (LLMs).

</details>


### [207] [Finite-Horizon Portfolio Choice, Labor Supply, and Early Retirement under Borrowing Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21382)
*Gugyum Ha,Junkee Jeon,Jihoon Ok*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究了在借贷约束下，具有劳动供给灵活性和不可逆提前退休选项的有限时间最优消费与投资组合问题。通过对偶鞅方法转化为零和停时-奇异控制博弈，利用变分不等式求解，并通过数值分析展示了劳动供给灵活性对消费、投资组合和退休时机的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究在借贷约束下，劳动供给灵活性如何影响个体的最优消费、投资组合选择和不可逆的提前退休决策，填补该领域在有限时间框架下的理论空白。

Method: 采用对偶鞅方法将原问题转化为零和停时-奇异控制博弈；通过对偶值函数满足的带障碍和梯度约束的极小-极大抛物型变分不等式进行求解；通过验证定理识别强解与博弈值函数，并利用对偶关系恢复原始最优策略。

Result: 证明了梯度约束自由边界（即绑定边界）关于日历时间单调递增；得到了最大强解是唯一可容许强解；通过数值分析恢复了值函数和最优策略，揭示了劳动供给灵活性如何影响消费、投资组合和退休时机。

Conclusion: 劳动供给灵活性显著改变了个体的最优消费、投资组合选择和退休决策，特别是在借贷约束下，灵活性可以缓解流动性约束对退休时机的负面影响。

Abstract: We study a finite-horizon optimal consumption and portfolio problem with labor supply flexibility and an irreversible early retirement option under a borrowing constraint. The agent chooses consumption, risky investment, and leisure before retirement, while after retirement labor income disappears and leisure is fixed at its maximal level. Preferences are described by a Cobb--Douglas utility, and wealth must remain nonnegative.
  {Using a dual martingale method, we transform the primal problem into a zero-sum stopper--singular-controller game. The associated dual value is characterized by a min--max parabolic variational inequality with obstacle and gradient constraints. We show that the maximal strong solution of the resulting variational inequality is the unique admissible strong solution whose gradient-constrained free boundary, namely the binding boundary, is monotone increasing in calendar time. A verification argument then identifies this strong solution with the value of the stopper--singular-controller game, and duality recovers the optimal retirement, consumption, leisure, and portfolio policies.}
  The numerical analysis recovers the value function and optimal policies, and illustrates how labor supply flexibility affects consumption, portfolio choice, and retirement timing under borrowing constraints.

</details>


### [208] [Unified Ergodic Primal-Dual Gap Rates with Unhalved Primal Stepsizes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21482)
*Sirong Dai,Ming Yan*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种"残差到对偶间隙传递原理"，通过控制Lyapunov函数的下降来利用单步间隙不等式中的正残差项，从而在未折半的原始步长τ<2/L条件下，为Condat–Vũ、PD3O、AFBA/PDDY和PAPC/PDFP²O等一阶原始-对偶方法建立了O(1/K)的遍历原始-对偶间隙界，同时给出了一个二维反例表明完全分离的矩形条件τ<2/L, τη‖A‖²<4/3在一般三函数设定下无法成立。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准间隙率证明通常施加折半的光滑步长条件τ≤1/L，尽管相应的收敛理论允许更大的范围τ<2/L。本文旨在弥合这一差距，证明在更大的未折半步长下仍能获得O(1/K)的遍历原始-对偶间隙界。

Method: 引入残差到对偶间隙传递原理（residual-to-gap transfer principle），即通过构造Lyapunov函数并控制其下降，将一步间隙不等式中的正残差项转化为间隙界的贡献，从而在τ<2/L条件下建立间隙上界。

Result: 在算法依赖的乘积条件下，对Condat–Vũ、PD3O、AFBA/PDDY和PAPC/PDFP²O等算法，在未折半的原始步长τ<2/L下得到了O(1/K)的遍历原始-对偶间隙界。同时给出了一个二维反例，证明完全分离的矩形条件τ<2/L, τη‖A‖²<4/3在一般三函数设定下无法成立。

Conclusion: 证明了在更宽松的步长条件下仍能获得最优的O(1/K)遍历间隙率，揭示了已有理论范围与证明技术之间的鸿沟可以通过残差传递原理弥合，同时反例也刻画了该条件下可达界的极限。

Abstract: We study ergodic primal-dual gap rates for first-order primal-dual methods applied to \[
  \min_x f(x)+g(x)+h(Ax), \] where $f$ is smooth and convex, $g$ and $h$ are proper, closed, convex functions, and $A$ is linear. Standard gap-rate proofs often impose the halved smooth-stepsize condition $τ\le 1/L$, even though the corresponding convergence theory allows the larger range $τ<2/L$. We introduce a residual-to-gap transfer principle: positive residual terms in the one-step gap inequality are controlled by the decrease of a Lyapunov function. This yields $O(1/K)$ ergodic primal-dual gap bounds with the unhalved primal stepsize $τ<2/L$ for Condat--Vũ, PD3O, AFBA/PDDY, and PAPC/PDFP$^2$O, under their algorithm-dependent product conditions. We also give a two-dimensional counterexample showing that the fully separated rectangle $τ<2/L$, $τη\|A\|^2<4/3$ cannot hold in the general three-function setting.

</details>


### [209] [A note on the convergence guarantees of RLT-based algorithms for polynomial optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21483)
*Alejandro Barros-González,Julio González-Díaz,Brais González-Rodríguez,Iria Rodríguez Acevedo*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文指出了多项式优化中RLT技术一项基础性结果的数学疏漏，添加一个自然假设即可恢复原结论的正确性，否则可能导致基于RLT的算法失去收敛保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 识别并纠正RLT基础结果中的数学疏漏，防止算法收敛性保证的丧失。

Method: 通过数学分析指出原证明中的疏漏，并提出添加一个微小的自然假设来修正。

Result: 原结果在添加一个自然假设后可被轻松恢复其正确性。

Conclusion: 对RLT基础结果中的疏漏进行修正，确保基于RLT的算法保持收敛性保证。

Abstract: This paper identifies and addresses a mathematical oversight in one of the foundational results on the Reformulation-Linearization Technique (RLT) for polynomial optimization. We then argue that, although correctness of the original result can be easily recovered by adding a minor and natural assumption, not being aware of this nuance may lead to the loss of convergence guarantees in RLT-based algorithms.

</details>


### [210] [Reference-Free, Long-Horizon Trajectory Optimization for Aggressive Autonomous Driving in Milliseconds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21486)
*Prayag Sharma,Jonathan Y. M. Goh,Franck Djeumou*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了无参考轨迹、全车辆动力学模型下的长时域实时最优控制问题，通过分析车辆刚度特性、积分方案选择、非线性求解器策略及动态平衡初值生成方法，在260米时域上实现了低至55毫秒的求解时间，并在高速避障中自然涌现出漂移行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作缺乏对无参考轨迹、全动力学模型下长时域实时轨迹生成的量化计算需求分析，且常采用低保真模型，牺牲了精度和控制力。本文旨在填补这一空白，探索能够实现实时求解的建模与求解器设计选择。

Method: 1）分析车辆刚度特性，比较不同积分方案，发现低阶A-稳定方法效果最优，求解时间差异可达两个数量级；2）研究内点法中屏障参数更新策略及Hessian矩阵不定性的保护技术对非线性求解器鲁棒性的影响；3）提出基于动态平衡的初值生成方法，将初始不可行性降低四个数量级。

Result: 在260米时域上实现低至55毫秒的求解时间；高速避障场景中漂移作为可行轨迹的必要组成部分自然涌现。

Conclusion: 通过合理的建模与求解器设计，可以在使用全动力学模型的情况下实现无参考、长时域轨迹的实时求解，为自动驾驶在极限工况下的安全运行提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Autonomous vehicles must generate long-horizon and dynamically feasible trajectories in real time-even when operating at the limits of vehicle handling-to ensure safe operation in adverse conditions. However, existing work rarely quantifies the computational demands of generating such trajectories without prior references, warm starts and often defaults to low-fidelity models, compromising accuracy and control authority. We investigate the modeling and solver design choices that enable real-time solution of long-horizon, reference-free optimal control problems (OCPs) using full vehicle dynamics. To this end, we analyze vehicle stiffness properties to justify the OCP's integration scheme and show that lower-order A-stable methods consistently outperform alternatives, with solve time differences reaching two orders of magnitude. We show that robust nonlinear solver performance hinges on understanding barrier parameter update strategies and safeguarding techniques for Hessian indefiniteness, inherent in some interior point methods. Lastly, we propose a computationally efficient method for generating initial guesses using dynamic equilibrium, unlocking real-time performance and reducing initial infeasibility by up to four orders of magnitude. Extensive benchmarking and high-fidelity BeamNG simulation demonstrate compute times as low as 55 ms over a 260 m horizon, including high-speed obstacle avoidance scenarios where drifting emerges as a necessary component of feasible trajectory generation.

</details>


### [211] [Accelerated and Stable Convergence with Anchored Optimistic Method](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21528)
*Motahareh Sohrabi,Jianxin You,Simon Lacoste-Julien,Eduard Gorbunov,Gauthier Gidel*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出广义乐观锚定方法(GOMA)族，在确定性和随机单调变分不等式/极小极大优化中分别实现最优加速最后迭代收敛率O(1/k²)和O(1/√k)，是首个无需方差缩减或增大批次即可在无约束随机单调Lipschitz变分不等式上达到最后迭代收敛率的工作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典方法(如外梯度法)每次迭代需要两次梯度查询，限制了其在在线和随机场景下的分析与应用；现有方法在随机单调Lipschitz变分不等式的无约束设置下缺乏最后迭代收敛保证。

Method: 提出广义乐观方法族(GOMA)，结合双时间尺度乐观更新和受Halpern迭代启发的锚定项；在随机设置下进一步提出简化单次梯度查询变体。

Result: 确定性设置：在单调Lipschitz算子上的平方梯度范数达到最优加速最后迭代率O(1/k²)；随机设置(无界方差)：单次查询变体达到O(1/√k)的最后迭代收敛率。

Conclusion: 首次在无约束随机单调Lipschitz变分不等式上，无需方差缩减或增大批次，实现最后迭代收敛保证，拓展了乐观方法的适用范围。

Abstract: We study first-order methods for solving monotone variational inequalities arising in min-max optimization. Classical approaches such as the extragradient method rely on two gradient queries per iteration, which limits their analysis and applicability in the online and stochastic settings. We propose a family of Generalized Optimistic Methods with Anchoring (GOMA), which combine two-time-scale optimistic updates with an anchoring term inspired by Halpern iteration. In the deterministic setting, GOMA achieves the optimal accelerated last-iterate rate $O(1/k^2)$ on the squared gradient norm for monotone Lipschitz operators. In the stochastic setting with unbounded variance, a simplified single-call variant of GOMA achieves a last-iterate convergence rate of $O(1/\sqrt{k})$ on the squared gradient norm. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first such guarantee for stochastic monotone Lipschitz variational inequalities in the unconstrained setting without variance reduction or growing batches.

</details>


### [212] [On Fixed-Time Stability of Continuous Dynamics for Non-Monotone Variational Inequalities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21573)
*Sina Arefizadeh,Kunal Garg,Angelia Nedić*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文针对非单调变分不等式（NMVI）问题，提出了新的动力学系统，分别实现了无约束和约束情形下解集的指数稳定性与固定时间稳定性，并通过数值仿真验证了方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有关于NMVI的研究大多关注算法的渐近收敛性，缺乏对解集指数稳定性和固定时间稳定性的理论分析。本文旨在填补这一空白，为NMVI问题提供更快的收敛保证。

Method: 针对无约束NMVI，构造了两种新的动力学系统：一种在非单调映射梯度的温和假设下实现指数稳定性；另一种通过修改动力学实现固定时间稳定性。针对约束NMVI，采用连续时间版本的Korpelevich方法并引入新的缩放因子，分别实现指数稳定性和固定时间稳定性。

Result: 所提出的动力学系统在无约束和约束NMVI上分别实现了指数稳定性和固定时间稳定性，数值仿真验证了方法的有效性，且固定时间稳定性的收敛时间与初始条件无关。

Conclusion: 本文为NMVI问题提供了具有强收敛保证的动力学方法，未来可进一步研究离散化变体的行为及相关拓展工作。

Abstract: Non-monotone variational inequalities (NMVI) are an important class of problems that generalize non-convex optimization and have various applications in optimization theory, machine learning, game theory, and economics, among others. Most existing work on NMVIs focuses on the asymptotic convergence of algorithms proposed to solve these problems. In this paper, we tackle the problems of exponential and fixed-time stability of the solution set of a class of NMVIs for both unconstrained and constrained problems. We first present novel conditions guaranteeing exponential stability of solutions to unconstrained NMVIs for a uniquely constructed dynamical system under mild assumptions on the gradient of the non-monotone map. Then, under similar assumptions, we construct another novel dynamical system whose equilibrium point is fixed-time stable, i.e., the trajectories reach the equilibrium within a fixed time, independent of the initial conditions. For the case of constrained NMVIs, we employ a continuous-time variant of the Korpelevich method for exponential stability of the solution set, and provide a novel scaling factor in the dynamics to achieve fixed-time stability. We illustrate the efficacy of the proposed modified dynamical systems through numerical simulations and conclude the paper with a brief note on the behavior of the discretized variant of the proposed dynamics and on further work that remains to be done.

</details>


### [213] [Nonsmooth Obstacles and Killed Resolvents in Reflected Stochastic Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21575)
*Louis Shuo Wang,Jiguang Yu,Ye Liang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究二维反射扩散的最优停时问题，提出测度值变分公式化，证明价值函数具有杀死预解表示，并给出自由边界的刻画。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在处理带有不可微支付函数（max型）的反射扩散最优停时问题时，基于非限制预解的公式通常无效，需要更精确的变分框架。

Method: 引入符号Radon测度描述停时增益Γ，其中奇异分量支持在扭结对角线{x1=αx2}上并显式计算；利用杀死预解表示V=G-R_r^C Γ修正传统公式；通过显式单调性假设建立停时集的epigraph形式，并利用杀死势迹条件刻画自由边界。

Result: 证明了价值函数的杀死预解表示，显式计算出扭结对角线上的奇异测度分量，在单调性假设下得到自由边界的迹条件刻画，并给出验证定理确保局部Lipschitz候选边界的最优性。

Conclusion: 该工作为具有非光滑支付函数的反射扩散最优停时问题提供了严格的测度值变分框架，修正了传统预解公式的缺陷，并为自由边界的数值计算和理论分析奠定了基础。

Abstract: We study an infinite-horizon optimal stopping problem for a normally reflected two-dimensional diffusion in the quadrant with nonsmooth max-type payoff \(G(x_1,x_2)=x_1\veeαx_2\). The main novelty is a measure-valued variational formulation: the stopping gain \(Γ=c+rG-\mathcal LG\) is shown to be a signed Radon measure whose singular component is supported on the kink diagonal \(\{x_1=αx_2\}\), and this component is computed explicitly. We prove that the value admits the killed-resolvent representation \[
  V=G-R_r^{\mathcal C}Γ, \] where the reflected diffusion is killed upon entry into the stopping set. This corrects the generally invalid unrestricted-resolvent formula. Under explicit monotonicity hypotheses, the stopping set has epigraph form, and the free boundary is characterized by a killed-potential trace condition. A verification theorem certifies locally Lipschitz candidate boundaries as optimal.

</details>


### [214] [Convergence Analysis of Muon-type Methods with Inexact LMO in the Degenerate Case](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21581)
*Xun Qian,Peter Richtárik*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究Muon类方法在非精确LMO（退化情况）下的收敛性，针对非凸和带权重衰减的星凸情形，提出了新假设并建立了层-wise (L0, L1)-光滑下的收敛率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Muon方法收敛分析大多假设LMO精确求解，或仅在非退化情形下保证收敛（即动量重缩放的最小奇异值有正下界）。实际中LMO通过迭代算法近似求解，亟需分析退化情形（奇异值可趋近于零）下的收敛性。

Method: 针对非精确LMO的退化场景提出新假设，在层-wise (L0, L1)-光滑假设下，分别对一般非凸情形和带权重衰减的星凸情形建立收敛率分析。

Result: 在退化情形下，为非凸和星凸（含权重衰减）两种情况建立了收敛率，填补了Muon方法在非精确LMO退化场景下的理论空白。

Conclusion: 本文扩展了Muon类方法的收敛理论，证明了即使动量重缩放的奇异值趋近于零，在适当假设下仍可保证收敛，为实际中采用近似LMO求解提供了理论支撑。

Abstract: Muon-type methods have demonstrated potentially superior performance over Adam and its variants, and have shown hyperparameter transferability across model sizes when specific norms are chosen for the LMO in deep architectures. However, while the LMO is solved approximately via iterative algorithms in practice, most convergence analyses consider the ideal case where the search direction is the exact solution to the LMO. Recently, the inexact Muon update was analyzed by Shulgin et al. [2025], which reveals a fundamental coupling between the inexactness and the optimal step size and momentum. However, the convergence is guaranteed for the non-degenerate case only, i.e., the smallest positive singular value of the rescaled momentum is assumed to be bounded below by some positive constant when the spectral norm is used. In this work, we investigate Muon-type methods with inexact LMO in the degenerate case, where the smallest positive singular value of the rescaled momentum can approach zero, for the general non-convex case and the star-convex case with weight decay. Novel assumptions are proposed to address the challenges posed by inexact LMO in such degenerate scenarios, and convergence rates are established under the layer-wise $(L^0, L^1)$-smooth assumption for both cases.

</details>


### [215] [Nonlinear Guidance for Arrival Time and Arrival Angle Control Using Trajectory Shaping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21643)
*Kun Wang,Andrés Infante Adrián*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文针对定常速度固定翼无人机的到达时间和角度控制问题，提出了一种非线性轨迹整形制导策略。通过将视角参数化为四阶多项式，将非线性制导问题转化为求解两个耦合非线性积分方程。开发了两阶段求解过程：第一阶段通过近似建立线性关系生成解析温启动初始解，第二阶段通过一维非线性方程精化初始解，最终作为原始二维非线性系统的初始猜测。数值仿真表明，该方法在高度非线性场景下也能获得接近开环最优解的结果，而现有方法可能无法生成可行解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有制导方法在高度非线性场景下难以生成可行解，且直接求解强耦合的两个非线性积分方程具有挑战性，因此需要开发一种有效的求解策略来实现精确的到达时间和角度控制。

Method: 将视角参数化为四阶多项式，将制导问题转化为两个耦合非线性积分方程的求解问题。提出两阶段求解过程：阶段一通过近似建立参数间的线性关系，推导出关于第一个参数的标量二次方程，生成解析温启动初始解；阶段二通过求解一维非线性方程精化初始解，再将其作为原始二维非线性系统的初始猜测进行求解。

Result: 数值仿真表明，所提方法在测试案例中得到的解非常接近开环最优解，即使在高度非线性场景（现有方法无法生成可行解）下也能有效工作。

Conclusion: 提出的两阶段求解策略有效解决了强耦合非线性积分方程的求解难题，实现了定常速度固定翼无人机的到达时间和角度精确控制，且在高度非线性场景下优于现有方法。

Abstract: This paper proposes a nonlinear trajectory shaping guidance strategy for arrival time and angle control of a constant-speed fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicle. The look angle is parameterized by a fourth-order polynomial. The nonlinear guidance problem is transformed into solving two coupled nonlinear integral equations with respect to two unknown guidance parameters. Directly solving these equations is challenging due to the strong coupling between the parameters. To address this, a two-stage solution procedure is developed. In the first stage, an analytical warm start is constructed. Specifically, by applying approximations, a linear relationship between the two guidance parameters is obtained. With this relationship, a scalar quadratic equation in the first guidance parameter is derived, leading to a good initial guess for the first guidance parameter. In the second stage, this initial guess is refined by solving a one-dimensional nonlinear equation. The obtained solution is finally used as the initial guess for solving the original two-dimensional nonlinear system of equations. Numerical simulations demonstrate that for the test cases, the obtained solution is very close to the open-loop optimal solution, even in highly nonlinear scenarios where some existing methods fail to generate a feasible solution.

</details>


### [216] [Optimal Control Problem with Mixed Control and State Constraints for Cancer Chemotherapy and Treatment Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21765)
*David Lassounon,Aziz Belmiloudi,Mounir Haddou*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文通过最优控制理论，以化疗药物浓度为控制变量，利用非线性反应-扩散方程建模，在混合控制与状态约束下最小化侵袭性肿瘤细胞密度，并通过肺癌模拟验证了策略有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 化疗的成功依赖于药物递送策略的有效性及其在杀伤癌细胞的同时最小化对健康组织损伤的能力，本文旨在通过控制化疗药物来最小化侵袭性肿瘤细胞的密度。

Method: 将化疗药物浓度作为控制变量，建立非线性反应-扩散方程描述药物对肿瘤进展的影响；先进行初边值问题的数学分析，再构建含混合控制和状态约束的最优控制问题，推导一阶最优性必要条件，最后通过数值模拟验证。

Result: 在恶性肺肿瘤 eradication 的数值模拟中，所提出的最优控制策略被证明是有效的。

Conclusion: 所提出的基于最优控制理论的化疗给药策略能够有效最小化肿瘤细胞密度，在肺肿瘤案例中验证了其可行性，为临床化疗方案优化提供了理论依据。

Abstract: The success of chemotherapy depends on the effectiveness of the drug delivery strategy and its ability to destroy cancer cells while minimizing damage to healthy tissues. The main objective of this work is to minimize the density of invasive tumour cells by controlling the chemotherapeutic agents. For this, we address an optimal control problem with mixed control and state constraints. The concentration of chemotherapeutic drugs is represented as a control variable. We use a nonlinear reaction-diffusion equation to describe the effect of drugs on the progression of invasive tumours. We start with the mathematical analysis of this initial boundary value problem. Then, we formulate the optimal control problem, explain the role of different constraints, and derive first-order necessary conditions of optimality. Finally, in order to demonstrate the efficiency of the proposed strategy, numerical simulations in the case of the eradication of malignant lung tumours, are presented and analysed.

</details>


### [217] [Local-to-Global Exactness of SDP Relaxations for Sparse QCQPs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21823)
*Masakazu Kojima,Sunyoung Kim,Naohiko Arima*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究了稀疏二次约束二次规划（QCQP）的半定规划（SDP）松弛的精确性条件，通过弦扩展的聚合稀疏模式图的最大团来构建局部到全局的框架，证明了当局部子SDP精确时，全局SDP松弛也精确。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为稀疏QCQP提供可验证的SDP松弛精确性条件，利用问题结构的稀疏性降低计算复杂度。

Method: 基于弦扩展的聚合稀疏模式图的最大团，将全局SDP松弛分解为团级子SDP问题，引入局部右端向量和一致性矩阵两个参数，建立局部到全局的精确性判定框架。

Result: 证明了若局部子SDP（由全局最优解确定参数后）是精确的，则原始全局SDP松弛也是精确的。在团交集至多一个节点的假设下，识别了三类可纳入该框架的局部QCQP：凸局部QCQP、符号模式条件刻画的可分离局部QCQP、以及约束数量有限的局部QCQP。

Conclusion: 该局部到全局的框架为稀疏QCQP的SDP松弛精确性提供了系统性的判定方法，且不同类别的局部QCQP可在稀疏问题中灵活组合应用。

Abstract: We study exact semidefinite programming (SDP) relaxation for a given sparse quadratically constrained quadratic program (QCQP). The SDP relaxation is exact if, whenever it has an optimal solution, it admits a rank-at-most-one optimal solution that corresponds to an optimal solution of the QCQP. Using the maximal cliques of a chordal extension of the aggregate sparsity pattern graph of the data matrices, we formulate the SDP relaxation in terms of clique-wise matrix variables and develop a local-to-global framework for certifying exactness. For each clique-wise matrix variable, we introduce a local sub-SDP with two parameters: a local right-hand-side vector and a consistency matrix specifying the values of entries shared by overlapping clique-wise matrix variables. In the main theorem, these parameters are determined by an optimal solution of the global clique-wise SDP. The theorem shows that if the resulting local sub-SDPs are exact, then the original SDP relaxation is exact. Under the additional assumption that any two distinct cliques intersect in at most one node, we present three classes of local QCQPs that can be incorporated into this framework: convex local QCQPs, local QCQPs characterized by sign-pattern conditions, and separable local QCQPs with a limited number of constraints. Examples illustrate how these different local QCQP classes can be combined in sparse QCQPs.

</details>


### [218] [PhiBE-Q-Learning: Bridging Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning and Continuous-Time Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21925)
*Yuhua Zhu,Yutong Ren*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文针对连续时间强化学习(CTRL)中的离策略学习问题，提出了新的状态-动作价值函数定义及其控制方程，并基于PhiBE近似开发了迭代算法，在线性函数近似下建立了收敛性保证和显式收敛速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续时间强化学习中经典的状态-动作价值函数Q(s,a)不存在，导致无法直接应用离策略学习方法；而连续时间控制中的瞬时优势函数q(s,a)依赖状态价值函数V(s)，限制了离策略学习的可行性。

Method: 提出了CTRL中状态-动作价值函数的新定义并推导其控制方程；基于PhiBE近似，在模型已知和模型未知两种设置下，利用离散时间离策略数据设计迭代算法逼近最优Q函数。

Result: 在线性函数近似下，证明了所提方法的收敛性，并推导出显式的收敛速率。

Conclusion: 本文为连续时间强化学习中的离策略学习提供了理论基础和可行的算法框架，弥合了连续时间控制与离散时间离策略学习之间的鸿沟。

Abstract: In this paper, we develop an off-policy method for continuous-time reinforcement learning (CTRL), where the system dynamics are governed by an unknown stochastic differential equation (SDE) and only discrete-time trajectory data are available. A central challenge is that the classical state-action value function $Q(s,a)$, which enables off-policy learning in discrete-time RL, does not exist in CTRL (Baird, 1994; Jia and Zhou, 2023; Tallec et al., 2019). On the other hand, continuous-time control provides local notions such as the instantaneous advantage function $q(s,a)$, but these typically rely on state value function $V(s)$. To address this, we introduce a new definition of the state-action value function in CTRL and derive its governing equation.
  Building on the PhiBE approximation (Zhu, 2024; Zhu et al., 2025), we propose iterative algorithms to approximate the optimal $Q$-function in both model-based and model-free settings using only discrete-time off-policy data. Under linear function approximation, we establish convergence guarantees and derive explicit convergence rates for the proposed method.

</details>


### [219] [Active learning-based Bayesian optimization in the realm of copper slag-blended cement systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21948)
*Debadri Som,Rayna Maheshwari,Mathijs Schuurmans,Panagiotis Patrinos,Yiannis Pontikes*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文证明了贝叶斯优化（BO）能够在极少量实验数据（初始仅10次实验，数据与变量比2:1）条件下，快速识别出铜渣、石灰石、波特兰水泥体系中的近最优低碳胶凝材料配方，在满足强度要求的同时实现低于500 kg CO2/吨的排放目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统实验方法需要大量测试才能优化低碳辅助性胶凝材料（SCMs）的配合比，效率低下，亟需一种数据高效的优化方法来加速混合设计流程。

Method: 采用贝叶斯优化（BO）框架，以高斯过程为代理模型，结合期望提升（EI）和上置信界（UCB）采集函数，在2:1数据-变量比的严格数据约束下，从10组初始实验开始迭代优化铜渣-石灰石-波特兰水泥体系的2天抗压强度、成本和CO₂排放。

Result: 在2-6次迭代内即识别出帕累托非支配解，满足2天＞10 MPa、28天＞32.5 MPa的强度要求，CO₂排放低于500 kg/吨；线性核在预测精度上优于非线性核，但径向基函数（RBF）核因不确定性量化更优而更适合主动学习；保守更新策略（引入28天强度不确定性界）实现了无需等待28天即可快速迭代。

Conclusion: 贝叶斯优化在严重数据约束条件下可作为水泥研究的实用决策支持工具，显著加速低碳胶凝材料的配方优化。

Abstract: Accelerated mix design optimization is critical for deploying low-carbon supplementary cementitious materials (SCMs) because traditional experimental approaches require extensive testing campaigns. The authors demonstrate that Bayesian optimization (BO) can identify near-optimal blended cement formulations using an AI-driven approach with minimal experimental data. Starting with only 10 initial experiments and a 2:1 data-to-variable ratio reflecting realistic laboratory constraints, the authors optimized copper slag, limestone, Portland cement systems for 32.5N strength class with respect to 2-day compressive strength, cost, and CO2 emissions. Gaussian process surrogate models guided sequential experimentation through Expected Improvement and Upper Confidence Bound acquisition functions. Within 2-6 iterations, BO identified Pareto non-dominated solutions meeting strength requirements (greater than 10 MPa at 2 days, greater than 32.5 MPa at 28 days) while achieving CO2 emissions below 500 kg CO2/ton; consistent with industry decarbonization targets. A conservative update strategy incorporating uncertainty bounds for 28-day strength enabled rapid iteration without waiting 28 days per cycle. Comparative analysis revealed that linear kernels outperformed nonlinear alternatives in predictive accuracy, though radial basis function kernels were preferred for active learning due to superior uncertainty quantification. This work demonstrates BO as a practical decision-support tool for cement research under severe data constraints.

</details>


### [220] [Optimal Macroitem Sequences in the Precedence Constrained Knapsack Problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22018)
*Valerio Dose,Fabio Furini,Marco Locatelli*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究带优先约束的背包问题（PCKP）的线性规划松弛解的结构，提出了宏项（macroitem）和可行序列的概念，证明了最优LP解可通过宏项序列完全刻画，并针对森林结构的优先图设计了O(n²)及更优的算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解PCKP的LP松弛最优解的结构特性，为设计更高效的精确或近似算法提供理论基础。

Method: 引入宏项（macroitem）和可行序列概念，将物品集按优先关系划分为宏项并排序；利用参数化拉格朗日函数分析容量约束的断点与宏项利润-重量比的关系；对森林结构优先图设计O(n²)算法（向内/外向树可优化至O(n log n)）。

Result: 最优LP解由最优宏项序列完全刻画：物品按宏项利润-重量比非增序装入，至多一个宏项被部分装入；容量约束的参数化拉格朗日函数的断点与最优序列中宏项的利润-重量比一致；最优对偶解可通过宏项内的可行流组合刻画。

Conclusion: 建立了PCKP的LP松弛的结构化理论，为后续算法设计提供了理论基础；对森林结构图类给出了多项式时间算法。

Abstract: The Precedence Constrained Knapsack Problem (PCKP) asks for a maximum-profit subset of items, subject to a knapsack capacity constraint and precedence constraints encoded by a directed acyclic graph. We study the structure of optimal solutions of the Linear Programming (LP) relaxation of the natural Integer Linear Programming formulation of the PCKP. We introduce the notion of macroitem and of feasible sequence of macroitems, which partitions the item set while respecting the precedence structure. We establish that an optimal LP solution is fully characterized by the optimal sequence of macroitems: items are packed in nonincreasing order of the profit-to-weight ratio of their macroitem, with at most one macroitem fractionally included. We further show that the breakpoints of the parametric Lagrangian function of the capacity constraint coincide with the profit-to-weight ratios of the macroitems in the optimal sequence, and provide a complete combinatorial characterization of optimal dual solutions in terms of a feasible flow within each macroitem. Finally, for the special case in which the precedence graph is a forest, we devise an O(n^2) algorithm to compute the optimal sequence, which improves to O(n log n) for in-trees or out-trees, where n denotes the number of items.

</details>


### [221] [Information Design under Uncertain Utilities: Probabilistic and CVaR Approaches](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22157)
*Furkan Sezer*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究信息设计者在缺乏代理人支付系数精确知识时的信息设计问题，提出Cal-BCE概念，在LQG结构下建立凸SOCP和SDP重构，通过实验验证概率设计与CVaR设计的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有信息设计理论通常假设设计者完全知晓代理人的支付系数，但实际中设计者对此存在结构性不确定性。论文旨在解决设计者缺乏代理人支付系数精确知识时的信息设计问题。

Method: 提出Calibrated Bayes Correlated Equilibrium (Cal-BCE)概念，在BCE基础上引入校正策略以保持激励兼容性；在LQG结构下将非凸问题转化为凸的二阶锥规划(SOCP)和半定规划(SDP)重构，采用概率约束和条件风险价值(CVaR)约束两类框架。

Result: 两类设计均能限制代理人间的行动协方差，CVaR设计在共同容忍度下约束更紧；但设计依赖校准，实际排序随校准变化。十五个行业ETF实验表明：概率设计获得更高平均福利，CVaR设计提供更好的尾部保护，二者无绝对主导。

Conclusion: 在结构性不确定性下，概率设计与CVaR设计存在根本性权衡，设计者需根据风险偏好选择合适框架；Hadamard可逆性条件保证可行性，联合去中心化定理揭示两类设计的结构差异。

Abstract: This paper studies information design when the designer lacks precise knowledge of agents' payoff coefficients. The Calibrated Bayes Correlated Equilibrium (Cal-BCE) is introduced as a solution concept that augments the Bayes correlated equilibrium with a corrector policy preserving incentive compatibility under the designer's structural uncertainty, adapting its revelation principle to this setting. The design problem is nonconvex in general, but under a linear-quadratic-Gaussian structure it admits convex second-order cone and semidefinite reformulations under two-sided probabilistic and conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) constraints, with feasibility guaranteed by a Hadamard invertibility condition. A joint decentralization theorem shows that both designs cap cross-agent action covariances, the CVaR design more tightly at a common tolerance; but because the formulations operate at design-specific feasibility thresholds, the realized ordering is calibration-dependent. Experiments on fifteen sector ETFs confirm the trade-off: the probabilistic design attains higher mean welfare and the CVaR design better tail protection, with neither dominating outright.

</details>


### [222] [Ensemble Feedback Methods for Families of Linear Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22192)
*Michael Schönlein,Fabian Wirth*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究了一类在紧致参数集上定义的有限维线性系统族的反馈镇定问题。针对经典集成反馈无法修改本质谱、阻碍无穷维系统镇定的问题，引入了乘法反馈算子。对于常Hermite指标系统，证明了Heymann引理的类比、极点配置定理及镇定结果；对于非常Hermite指标系统，在额外参数集结构假设下获得了相应结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典集成反馈产生的紧致控制算子无法修改描述系统自由运动的乘法算子的本质谱，这阻碍了在无穷维框架下的系统镇定。因此需要引入新的反馈机制来解决这一局限。

Method: 引入乘法反馈算子替代经典集成反馈；对常Hermite指标系统证明Heymann引理的类比、极点配置定理；研究逐点可控性与集成可控性的关系；对非常Hermite指标系统在额外结构假设下推导类似结果。

Result: 对于常Hermite指标系统，成功建立了Heymann引理的类比、极点配置定理及镇定结果；对于非常Hermite指标系统，在参数集满足附加结构假设时获得了相应结论。

Conclusion: 乘法反馈算子能够有效解决经典集成反馈在无穷维系统中的镇定障碍，为参数化线性系统族的反馈镇定提供了新的理论工具。

Abstract: We consider feedback stabilization for one-parameter families of finite-dimensional linear systems over compact parameter sets in the complex field. Classical ensemble feedback induces compact control operators and therefore cannot modify the essential spectrum of the associated multiplication operators describing the free motion of the system. This precludes stabilization in many infinite-dimensional settings. To address this issue, multiplication feedback operators are introduced. For systems with constant Hermite indices, an analogue of Heymann's lemma is proved, as well as a pole placement theorem, and stabilization results. The relation of pointwise and ensemble controllability is investigated. For systems with nonconstant Hermite indices, corresponding results are obtained under additional assumptions on the structure of the parameter set.

</details>


### [223] [Adam Converges in Nonsmooth Nonconvex Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22326)
*Zijian Liu*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文首次对含偏差修正项且无额外修改的经典Adam算法进行了非光滑非凸优化的有限时间分析，证明了随机缩放学习率可达到$1/T^{\frac{2}{13}}$的收敛速率，且该结果适用于重尾噪声场景，参数选择$\beta_1=\beta_2$与近期实证研究一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Adam分析主要聚焦于光滑非凸优化中的收敛速率，无法解释其在非光滑实际场景（如神经网络训练）中的成功；且近期的Online-to-Nonconvex Conversion框架虽提供了新思路，但先前工作均忽略了Adam原始算法中的偏差修正项，且需额外操作（如裁剪步骤），因此原始Adam的收敛保证仍不明确。

Method: 采用Online-to-Nonconvex Conversion框架，对包含偏差修正项的经典Adam算法进行有限时间分析，引入随机缩放学习率策略，在非光滑非凸优化设定下推导收敛率，并拓展至重尾噪声场景。

Result: 证明了经典Adam在非光滑非凸优化中达到$1/T^{\frac{2}{13}}$的收敛速率；该结果适用于更贴近实际的重尾噪声环境；参数条件$\beta_1=\beta_2$与实证研究吻合。

Conclusion: 首次为原始Adam算法（含偏差修正、无需额外修改）提供了非光滑非凸优化的收敛保证，理论结果更符合实际应用场景，有助于解释Adam的广泛成功。

Abstract: Adam is one of the most widely implemented and influential modern optimizers. Why is it effective across different optimization problems in practice? This question arguably lies at the center of the optimization community over the last decade and has motivated a substantial body of work aimed at understanding its convergence behavior. However, existing studies have mainly focused on the convergence rate of Adam in smooth nonconvex optimization, which unfortunately does not adequately capture practical settings, since many real-world problems are nonsmooth, such as those arising in training neural networks. Thus, these studies cannot fully explain the popularity and empirical success of Adam.
  Recently, an insightful and powerful framework called Online-to-Nonconvex Conversion has opened a new way to analyze Adam for nonsmooth nonconvex optimization. Unfortunately, prior works along this line share two common limitations. First, all of them ignore the important bias-correction term in the original Adam algorithm. Second and more importantly, many of them require extra operations that are not used in Adam, such as a clipping step. Therefore, the convergence guarantee for the original Adam method still remains unclear.
  In this work, we present the first finite-time analysis for the classical form of Adam, i.e., with the bias-correction step and without further algorithmic modifications, and prove that a randomly scaled learning rate ensures a convergence rate of $1/T^{\frac{2}{13}}$ for nonsmooth nonconvex optimization. Moreover, our result provably applies to the modern heavy-tailed noise regime, which is closer to practice. Interestingly, our theory is established under the parameter choice $β_1=β_2$, aligning with the recent empirical studies.

</details>


### [224] [Convergence Rates of Tseng's Splitting Method and Its Acceleration Schemes for Monotone Inclusion Problem with a Sum of Hölder Continuous Operators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22392)
*Yi Zhang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究了在Hölder连续（弱于Lipschitz连续）假设下，Tseng分裂方法及其两种加速变体（复合额外锚定梯度法和辛复合额外梯度法）用于求解单调包含问题的收敛速率，并通过数值实验验证了理论速率与数值表现的一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单调包含问题的求解方法通常要求算子具有Lipschitz连续性，但Hölder连续性作为更弱的条件更能刻画某些实际问题。本文旨在弥合这一差距，探索在Hölder连续假设下经典算法及其加速变体的收敛性能。

Method: 在Hölder连续假设下，理论分析了Tseng分裂方法、复合额外锚定梯度法以及辛复合额外梯度法的收敛速率，并设计了数值实验进行验证。

Result: 数值实验表明，这些算法在Hölder连续条件下的实际数值表现与其理论收敛速率相一致。

Conclusion: Tseng分裂方法及其加速变体在Hölder连续假设下仍具有可证明的收敛速率，且理论结果与数值实践吻合，拓展了单调包含问题求解方法的适用条件。

Abstract: The monotone inclusion problem is fundamental in applied mathematics and is closely related to a wide range of practical applications. However, existing solution methods typically require the underlying operator to be Lipschitz continuous. Recently, Hölder continuity, a weaker condition than Lipschitz continuity, has proven useful in characterizing certain real-world problems. To bridge this gap, we investigate the convergence rates of the Tseng's splitting method (a fundamental algorithm for monotone inclusion problem) and its two accelerated variants, the composite extra anchored gradient method and the symplectic composite extra gradient method, under the Hölder continuity assumption. Our numerical experiments demonstrate that the numerical performance of these algorithms aligns with their respective theoretical convergence rates.

</details>


### [225] [A Dual ADMM Framework for Inverse Parameter Identification in Elliptic Variational Inequalities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22467)
*Youness Mezzan,Youssef Ouakrim,Abderrahim Zafrar*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究由第二类椭圆变分不等式（含非可微边界泛函）支配的反向参数识别问题，通过改进的增广拉格朗日-ADMM方法，在保留非光滑结构的前提下重构Robin型系数，并验证了可辨识性、收敛性和数值有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法通常对非光滑变分不等式进行光滑化近似，这可能会破坏原问题的内在非光滑结构，导致参数重构精度下降或计算效率降低。本文旨在发展一种无需光滑化近似的鲁棒反演框架。

Method: 将逆问题表述为带Tikhonov正则化的约束优化问题；将状态问题重述为约束极小化问题；采用增广拉格朗日框架结合交替方向乘子法(ADMM)求解；利用Fenchel对偶处理非可微边界项，避免引入光滑化近似。

Result: 建立了未知系数的可辨识性；证明了所提逼近方案的存在性和收敛性；在经典基准问题上的数值实验证实了理论分析，表明该方法能以更少的计算代价实现精确的参数重构。

Conclusion: 所提出的方法为热传导、摩擦接触和腐蚀检测等应用中的逆问题提供了一个鲁棒的高效求解框架。

Abstract: This paper is concerned with an inverse parameter identification problem governed by a second-kind elliptic variational inequality involving a non-differentiable boundary functional. The objective is to reconstruct an unknown Robin-type coefficient from boundary measurements while preserving the intrinsic nonsmooth structure of the underlying model. The inverse problem is formulated as a constrained optimization problem, where the cost functional measures the discrepancy between the computed and observed data and is stabilized by Tikhonov regularization. To overcome the difficulties associated with the nonsmooth variational inequality, we reformulate the state problem as a constrained minimization problem and employ an augmented Lagrangian framework combined with the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM). Fenchel duality is used to treat the non-differentiable boundary term without introducing smoothing approximations. We establish identifiability of the unknown coefficient and prove existence and convergence results for the proposed approximation scheme. Numerical experiments performed on a classical benchmark problem confirm the theoretical analysis and demonstrate that accurate parameter reconstruction can be achieved with reduced computational effort. The proposed methodology provides a robust framework for inverse problems arising in applications such as heat transfer, frictional contact, and corrosion detection.

</details>


### [226] [Quantum Restricted Boltzmann Machine for Fast Unit Commitment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22542)
*Yuji Cao,Yue Chen*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于量子受限玻尔兹曼机（qRBM）的机组组合（UC）问题求解方法，先用量子硬件兼容的能量评分预测UC模式，再通过仿射映射恢复最优解。相比现有工作，该方法在相同UC问题上所需量子比特减少了223倍，计算时间减少了99.96%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机组组合问题需要反复求解以保证电力系统可靠性，但随着系统规模扩大和响应速度要求提高，传统计算方法面临巨大计算挑战。

Method: 提出量子受限玻尔兹曼机（qRBM）方法，首先通过量子硬件兼容的能量评分预测UC模式，然后利用仿射映射恢复最优解。

Result: 与现有工作相比，在相同UC问题上所需量子比特减少了223倍，计算时间减少了99.96%。

Conclusion: qRBM方法能显著降低量子资源消耗和计算时间，为大规模UC问题的高效求解提供了新途径。

Abstract: Unit commitment (UC) problems must be solved repeatedly to ensure power system reliability, yet face computational challenges from growing system scale and fast response requirements. This letter proposes a quantum restricted Boltzmann machine (qRBM) method that first predicts UC patterns via quantum-hardware-compatible energy scoring, then recovers optimal solutions through affine mapping. Compared to existing work, this method reduces the qubits needed for the same UC problem by 223 times and computation time by 99.96%.

</details>


### [227] [A Geometric Solution of the Schrödinger Bridge Problem on $\mathsf{SO}(2)$ via Stochastic Optimal Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22690)
*Hamza Mahmood,Adeel Akhtar*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文针对李群SO(2)上的运动学方程，提出了一种几何坐标无关的薛定谔桥问题(SBP)解。通过将角速度作为控制输入，证明了在连续严格正的初始和终端概率密度函数下，SO(2)上薛定谔方程组的解存在唯一性，并利用希尔伯特投影度量下的压缩不动点递归实现了几何控制器设计，最后通过数值仿真验证了理论的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为SO(2)上的薛定谔桥问题提供一种无需嵌入欧几里得平面的、完全基于李群内在几何结构的无坐标求解方法，实现最优密度控制。

Method: 将角速度作为控制输入，将SBP转化为求解SO(2)上的薛定谔方程组；通过希尔伯特投影度量证明不动点递归在完备度量空间中的压缩性，从而证明解的存在唯一性；利用SO(2)的内在几何结构设计几何控制器，避免欧几里得嵌入。

Result: 证明了SO(2)上薛定谔系统方程组解的存在唯一性，并通过数值仿真验证了理论构造的薛定谔桥的有效性。

Conclusion: 提出了一种完全基于SO(2)内在几何结构的坐标无关SBP求解方法，为李群上的最优密度控制提供了理论框架，数值实验验证了方法的可行性。

Abstract: We present a geometric coordinate-free solution to the isotropic Schrödinger bridge problem (SBP) for the kinematic equation on the Lie group $\mathsf{SO}(2)$. We consider the angular velocity of the system as the control input and assume that the given initial and terminal state probability density functions defined on $\mathsf{SO}(2)$ in our SBP are continuous and strictly positive. We solve the SBP by proving the existence and uniqueness of a solution to the so-called Schrödinger system of equations on $\mathsf{SO}(2)$, by showing that a fixed-point recursion is contractive in a complete metric space with respect to the Hilbert's projective metric. The geometric controller thus designed only uses the intrinsic geometric structure of $\mathsf{SO}(2)$ and does not embed it in the Euclidean plane to achieve the optimal density control. The numerical simulation verifies the validity of the theoretical construction of the Schrödinger bridge. The code and animations are publicly available at \texttt{\href{https://gitlab.com/a5akhtar/sbp}{https://gitlab.com/a5akhtar/sbp}}.

</details>


### [228] [A Variable-Metric Non-monotone Line Search Method for Mixed Variational Inequalities and Equilibrium Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22869)
*Mohammed Alshahrani*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于变尺度投影与非单调Armijo线搜索的隙函数方法，用于求解变分不等式、混合变分不等式和均衡问题，在强单调Lipschitz条件下具有全局收敛性和R-线性收敛速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的隙函数方法在收敛速度和算法稳定性方面仍有改进空间，特别是在处理大规模或病态问题时，固定度量的投影步骤可能导致收敛缓慢。本文旨在结合变度量投影和非单调线搜索，设计一种兼具理论保障和实际高效性的新方法。

Method: 1) 构建结构恒等式：变度量投影步骤恰好是Fukushima正则化隙函数的极大值点；2) 搜索方向同时是算法步骤和隙定义方向；3) 采用变度量（固定或受控变化）的缩放投影；4) 结合修正的非单调Armijo线搜索；5) 对均衡问题采用Mastroeni隙函数。

Result: 1) 对强单调Lipschitz变分/混合变分不等式：全局收敛 + R-线性收敛速度；2) 对均衡问题：全局收敛 + Mastroeni隙误差界；3) 数值实验验证了收敛性保证和预测收敛速度，优于标准外梯度和隙下降方法。

Conclusion: 变度量缩放、非单调线搜索和隙函数下降的组合是这类问题的新方案，提供了理论保证和数值优势。

Abstract: We propose a scaled gap-function method for variational inequalities, mixed variational inequalities, and equilibrium problems over a closed convex set. The method drives a gap function to zero by combining a variable-metric scaled projection step with a modified non-monotone Armijo line search. The construction rests on a structural identity: the scaled projection step is exactly the maximizer that defines the Fukushima regularized gap, so the search direction is simultaneously the algorithmic step and the gap-defining direction. For variational and mixed variational inequalities with a strongly monotone, Lipschitz operator we establish global convergence and an R-linear rate, under a fixed or a controlled-change variable metric. The rate follows from the strong-monotonicity contraction and the resulting explicit gap error bound. For equilibrium problems we obtain global convergence and a gap error bound (Mastroeni's gap). Numerical experiments on controlled problems confirm the convergence guarantees and the predicted rate, and compare the method with standard extragradient and gap-descent methods. The combination of variable-metric scaling, a modified non-monotone line search, and gap-function descent appears to be new for these problem classes.

</details>


### [229] [Sparsity-Cone SDP Relaxations and Applications to Variable Fixing for Sparse Quadratic Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22894)
*Di Hou,Thai P. D. Nguyen,Kim-Chuan Toh,Guanyi Wang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种稀疏锥半定规划（SC-SDP）松弛方法用于稀疏（不定）二次规划，该方法使用(n+1)维矩阵和单个稀疏锥约束替代标准SDP-RLT松弛中的(2n+1)维半定矩阵，在保持相同松弛强度的同时显著提升计算效率，并推导了显式预求解机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏二次规划（QPs）通常是NP-hard的，其高效全局求解依赖于紧的凸松弛。标准SDP-RLT松弛虽然紧，但涉及(2n+1)维半定矩阵，计算代价高昂，需要更高效的松弛方法。

Method: 提出SC-SDP松弛，使用(n+1)维矩阵加单一稀疏锥约束K；证明其与SDP-RLT等价；推导稀疏锥K的结构特征并证明投影可高效计算；基于对偶推导显式预求解机制（对偶固定规则、筛选切割规则、对偶细化步骤）；设计两阶段基于黎曼流形的增广拉格朗日方法。

Result: 数值实验表明，SC-SDP在保持与SDP-RLT相同边界质量的前提下，具有显著的计算优势，并且预求解机制在实践中有效。

Conclusion: SC-SDP为稀疏二次规划提供了一种兼具松弛质量和计算效率的可行方案，其预求解机制进一步增强了实际求解能力。

Abstract: Quadratic programs (QPs) with sparsity constraint are generally NP-hard, and their efficient global solution depends crucially on tractable tight convex relaxations. In this paper, we propose a sparsity-cone semidefinite programming (SC-SDP) relaxation for sparse (indefinite) QPs. Unlike standard SDP liftings, such as the SDP--RLT relaxation, which involve a $(2n+1)$-dimensional semidefinite matrix, the proposed SC-SDP formulation uses only a $(n+1)$-dimensional matrix together with a single sparsity-cone constraint $\mathcal{K}$ to handle the relaxation of the $\ell_0$-norm constraint. We prove that SC-SDP is equivalent in strength to the SDP--RLT relaxation. We further study the sparsity cone $\mathcal{K}$, deriving structural characterizations and showing that projection onto $\mathcal{K}$ can be computed efficiently via a one-dimensional subproblem. Building on the dual of SC-SDP, we derive explicit presolving mechanisms, including a dual-fixing rule for individual variables, a screening-cut rule for excluding larger support patterns, and a dual-refinement step for improving presolving certificates. To solve the resulting relaxation SC-SDP efficiently, we develop a two-phase Riemannian-based augmented Lagrangian method and exploits the structured projection subproblems. Numerical experiments on several classes of sparse QPs show that SC-SDP preserves the bound quality of SDP--RLT while offering substantial computational advantages and practically effective presolving capabilities.

</details>


### [230] [Diffusions with resetting boundaries: ergodic control and renewal optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22990)
*Sergey Nikitin*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究了一类具有重置边界的一维扩散过程的遍历优化问题，推导了带非局部边界条件的HJB方程，建立了验证定理，并分析了再生扩散的遍历成本显式公式及最优漂移参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究具有重置边界的一维扩散过程的遍历优化问题，这类过程在达到指定边界点时按给定分布立即重置，具有广泛的实际应用背景（如排队论、随机网络等）。

Method: 1. 推导了带非局部边界条件的Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman方程；2. 建立了最优平稳Markov控制的验证定理；3. 利用再生结构推导了遍历成本的显式公式；4. 在无限惩罚机制下分析了最优遍历成本。

Result: 1. 建立了HJB方程及验证定理；2. 在单重置单反射边界情况下，在弱可积条件下证明了存在性；3. 给出了再生扩散遍历成本的显式公式；4. 通过多个例子显式刻画了最优漂移参数。

Conclusion: 成功将遍历优化理论推广至具有重置边界的扩散过程，所得显式公式和最优参数刻画具有理论价值和潜在应用意义。

Abstract: We study ergodic optimization problems for one-dimensional diffusions with resetting boundaries, namely diffusions that are instantaneously reset according to prescribed distributions upon reaching designated boundary points. For controlled diffusions with resetting boundaries, we consider optimization of the ergodic cost over a broad class of admissible real-time controls. We derive a Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman equation with non-local boundary conditions and establish a verification theorem for optimal stationary Markov controls. In the case of one resetting and one reflecting boundary, we also prove an existence result under weak integrability assumptions.
  We then study renewal diffusions. Using their regenerative structure, we derive explicit formulas for the ergodic cost. These formulas are applied to optimization problems over families of drift coefficients, yielding explicit characterizations of optimal drift parameters in several examples. Finally, we study an infinite-penalty regime in which boundary hitting is prohibited and characterize the corresponding optimal ergodic cost.

</details>


### [231] [Towards time-variant scenario reduction for energy system optimization modeling under uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23072)
*Yannick Werner,Juan Miguel Morales,Salvador Pineda,Sonja Wogrin*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出一种时变场景缩减框架，允许场景概率随时间变化，从而在能源系统随机规划中更灵活地捕捉关键时段的投资决策信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有场景缩减方法忽视长期规划中场景的时间序列特性，导致模型缩减效率受限。

Method: 提出时变场景缩减框架，允许场景聚合随时间变化，使场景概率成为时变变量。

Result: 相比传统时不变方法，该方法在发电扩容规划问题中展现出更高的灵活性。

Conclusion: 时变场景缩减能够更准确地捕捉驱动投资决策的关键时段的场景实现及其概率，有效提升模型缩减效率。

Abstract: Stochastic programming has become a popular tool for supporting decision-making under uncertainty in the long-term planning of energy systems. Existing scenario reduction methods, however, are naive about the long-term temporal nature of scenarios, which limits their efficiency in reducing model size. In this paper, we overcome this inefficiency by proposing a novel time-variant scenario reduction framework that explicitly allows for varying scenario aggregations over time. As a result, scenario probabilities become time-variant, enabling not only the accurate capture of scenario realizations but also their probabilities at the time steps that drive investment decisions. This substantially increases flexibility compared to traditional time-invariant methods, which we demonstrate on a two-stage stochastic generation expansion planning problem with uncertain renewable power production.

</details>


### [232] [On the gain of entrainment in stable linear control systems with a nonlinear output](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23149)
*Ram Massas,Michael Margaliot*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究了连续时间稳定线性控制系统中非线性输出映射导致的增益（GOE）现象。线性系统输出为线性时GOE为零，但非线性输出会产生非零GOE。推导了GOE的二阶特征，证明输出映射曲率决定主导贡献；若输出在可控子空间上凸（凹），则GOE非负（非正）。GOE可解释为平均Bregman散度。对于二次输出函数，给出了频域公式、符号条件、谐波贡献分析及最优周期激励。通过RLC电路和药效学模型验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究非线性输出映射如何使稳定线性控制系统在周期输入下产生比恒定输入（均值相同）更大的平均输出，即增益（GOE）现象的机制与特征。

Method: 采用二阶泰勒展开对平滑输出映射进行GOE特征化，推导曲率主导的贡献公式；利用凸凹性分析输出映射与GOE符号的关系；引入Bregman散度进行几何解释；对二次输出函数推导频域公式及最优激励条件。

Result: 建立了GOE与输出映射曲率之间的定量关系，给出了凸凹性条件下的符号判定准则，揭示了GOE作为平均Bregman散度的几何本质，导出了二次输出函数的频域解析条件及最优周期激励解。

Conclusion: 非线性输出映射的曲率是产生GOE的根本原因，凸凹性决定其符号方向，频域方法可精确分析谐波贡献并优化激励设计，理论在电路和药效学模型中具有实用价值。

Abstract: A control system admits a positive gain of entrainment (GOE) if entrainment to a periodic input yields a larger output, on average, than the output generated by the corresponding constant input with the same mean value. We analyze GOE in continuous-time stable linear control systems with a static nonlinear output map. Although linear systems with linear outputs have zero GOE, we show that a nonlinear output may generate a nontrivial GOE through the mismatch between the average output along the entrained periodic orbit and the output evaluated at the corresponding averaged equilibrium. We derive a second-order characterization of GOE for smooth output maps revealing that the leading-order contribution is determined by the curvature of the output map. We then show that if the output is convex (concave) on the controllable subspace, then GOE is nonnegative (nonpositive) for every periodic input. Furthermore, GOE admits a natural geometric interpretation as the average Bregman divergence between the entrained periodic orbit and the equilibrium associated with the averaged input. For the special case of quadratic output functions, we derive explicit frequency-domain formulas for GOE. These yield necessary and sufficient conditions guaranteeing the sign of GOE, characterize the contribution of individual input harmonics, and lead to an optimal periodic excitation that maximizes GOE under an energy constraint. The theoretical results are illustrated using an electrical RLC circuit and a compartmental pharmacodynamic model with a nonlinear drug-effect map.

</details>


### [233] [Incremental Learning in Mirror Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23198)
*Raphaël Berthier,Loucas Pillaud-Vivien*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 研究由凸二次损失和一般凸下半连续镜像势生成的镜像流，发现当初始点靠近镜像势定义域边界时，其重新缩放轨迹收敛到以定义域指示函数为势的极限镜像流，此时原始变量在依赖于时间的假设集上最小化损失，这一机制解释了镜像流中的增量学习现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解镜像流在靠近定义域边界时的渐近行为，揭示其与增量学习之间的内在联系。

Method: 通过分析凸二次损失与一般凸下半连续镜像势生成的镜像流，研究初始点靠近定义域边界时重新缩放轨迹的收敛性质，并利用支撑函数的次微分进行刻画。

Result: 重新缩放后的镜像流轨迹收敛到以定义域指示函数为势的极限镜像流；在极限情况下，原始变量在依赖于时间的假设集上最小化损失，该假设集由支撑函数的次微分决定。

Conclusion: 揭示了镜像流中增量学习的一般机制，为理解镜像流在边界附近的动态行为提供了理论基础。

Abstract: We study mirror flows generated by a convex quadratic loss and a general convex lower semicontinuous mirror potential. We show that, when initialized near the boundary of the domain of the mirror potential, their rescaled trajectories converge to a limiting mirror flow whose potential is the indicator function of the domain. In this limit, the primal variable minimizes the loss over a time-dependent hypothesis set: the subdifferential of the support function of the domain, evaluated at the dual variable. This characterization provides a general mechanism for incremental learning in mirror flows.

</details>


### [234] [Path-following Control of a Quadrotor using Quasi-Static Transverse Feedback Linearization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23218)
*Mohamed Al Lawati,Adeel Akhtar*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出了一种准静态横向反馈线性化（QSTFL）控制器，用于四旋翼无人机沿几何路径（而非时间参数化轨迹）进行路径跟踪，无需引入额外控制器状态，且推力输入由当前状态代数计算，无需推力导数测量和数值积分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的动态反馈方法需要引入额外的控制器状态，且需要推力导数测量和数值积分，计算复杂。本文旨在设计一种更简洁、计算复杂度更低的路径跟踪控制器，避免上述问题。

Method: 采用准静态横向反馈线性化方法，构造路径跟踪流形并使其不变，建立微分同胚坐标变换，推导推力和力矩输入的闭式解，仅需对3×3解耦矩阵求逆（而非4×4）。

Result: 证明了路径跟踪流形的局部指数稳定性；数值仿真验证了方法的有效性；控制器仅需3×3矩阵求逆，计算复杂度低于动态反馈方法。

Conclusion: QSTFL控制器能够在无需额外控制器状态的情况下实现四旋翼的几何路径跟踪，具有更低的计算复杂度和良好的稳定性保证。

Abstract: We propose a quasi-static transverse feedback linearization (QSTFL) controller for a quadrotor to follow a prescribed geometric path, rather than a time-parameterized trajectory. In contrast to existing dynamic-feedback approaches, the controller does not introduce additional controller states. The thrust input is computed algebraically from the current state, eliminating the need for thrust-derivative measurements and numerical integration. The proposed design renders the path-following manifold invariant, ensuring that trajectories initialized on the path remain on it for all future time, while simultaneously regulating tangential velocity and yaw. We establish a diffeomorphic coordinate transformation and prove local exponential stability of the path-following manifold. In addition, closed-form expressions are derived for the thrust and torque inputs. Compared with dynamic-feedback constructions, the controller requires inversion of only a $3\times 3$ decoupling matrix rather than a $4\times 4$ one, leading to a simpler control law and reduced computational complexity. Numerical simulations demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method. Code and animations are publicly available at \footnotesize{\texttt{\href{https://gitlab.com/a5akhtar/quasistatic-tfl-uav/}{https://gitlab.com/a5akhtar/quasistatic-tfl-uav/}}}.

</details>


### [235] [Value iteration with stopping criterion: finite iterations, stability, and near-optimality guarantees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23229)
*Mathieu Granzotto,Romain Postoyan,Dragan Nešić,Lucian Buşoniu,Jamal Daafouz*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究了值迭代算法在无限时域离散时间确定性系统中的停止准则设计，证明在温和假设下算法有限步终止，并建立了最终策略的稳定性与显式近最优性界，为平衡计算开销与性能保障提供了设计框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际应用中值迭代必须在有限次迭代后停止，但何时停止才能保证所得策略和价值函数满足近最优性和稳定性等理想性质，这是一个关键但尚未充分研究的问题。

Method: 针对无限时域（可能折扣）代价的确定离散时间系统，提出一种广义停止准则（涵盖现有选择并允许新设计）；在温和假设下证明有限步终止，并通过恰当设计停止准则证明最终策略的稳定性，推导显式的近最优性界。

Result: 1) 值迭代在温和假设下有限步终止；2) 通过适当设计停止准则，最终策略是稳定的；3) 推导出由停止准则选择决定的显式近最优性界。

Conclusion: 本文为值迭代的停止准则提供了一套设计框架，能够在计算开销与稳定性、性能保障之间进行权衡。

Abstract: Value iteration (VI) is a cornerstone of dynamic programming that allows computing near-optimal feedback laws for general plant dynamics and cost functions. In practice, however, it must be stopped after finitely many iterations. This raises the question of when to stop the algorithm so that the resulting policies and value functions achieve desirable properties, like given near-optimality bounds and stability. In this context, we study deterministic, discrete-time systems with infinite-horizon (possibly discounted) costs whose inputs are generated by VI. We equip VI with a generalized stopping criterion that encompasses existing choices while allowing new ones. Our aim is to analyze the properties of the policies and value functions at the final iteration. Under mild assumptions, we first show that VI indeed terminates in a finite number of iterations. We then establish that the final policies are stabilizing by properly designing the stopping criterion, and derive explicit near-optimality bounds characterized by this choice. These results offer a design framework for the stopping criteria that balances computational effort with stability and performance guarantees.

</details>


### [236] [A First-Order Mean Field Control Analysis of Transformer Layers under Cross-Entropy Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23235)
*Cheng Huan,Hongwei Yuan*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文从平均场控制视角研究Transformer残差层，将深度视为时间、层参数视为控制，证明有限深度轨迹的O(ε)路径逼近和交叉熵风险的采样界，并推导出庞特里亚金条件等理论结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将Transformer残差网络的训练问题形式化为一个连续深度平均场控制问题，从而在理论上理解层数、参数与训练动态之间的深层关系。

Method: 采用连续深度平均场控制视角：将深度视为时间、层参数视为控制、残差Transformer递归视为受控隐状态流的显式欧拉格式；证明有限深度轨迹的路径逼近和交叉熵经验风险的采样界；将极限种群问题建模为隐状态律的一阶输运控制问题；推导含Softmax残差的庞特里亚金条件；给出有限类和度量熵的一致估计。

Result: 证明了O(ε)的路径逼近误差；给出了高概率的经验交叉熵风险采样界；推导了包含Softmax残差的庞特里亚金条件；获得了有限类和度量熵的一致估计；讨论了最优值比较、存在性、稳定性、连续到离散恢复、初始化和连续极小化子的范围估计。

Conclusion: 该工作为Transformer残差网络的训练提供了严格的理论分析框架，展示了平均场控制方法在理解深度学习优化动态中的有效性。

Abstract: We study Transformer-type residual layers under cross-entropy training through a continuous-depth mean field control viewpoint. Depth is treated as time, layer parameters as controls, and the residual Transformer recursion as an explicit Euler scheme for a controlled hidden-state flow. For fixed controls, we prove an $O(\varepsilon)$ pathwise approximation of finite-depth trajectories by the continuous flow and combine this with high-probability sampling bounds for the empirical cross-entropy risk. We formulate the limiting population problem as a first-order transport control problem for the law of hidden states and derive a Pontryagin condition whose terminal adjoint contains the softmax residual. We also give finite-class and metric-entropy uniform estimates, compare optimal values, and discuss existence, stability, continuous-to-discrete recovery, initialization, and range estimates for continuous minimizers.

</details>


### [237] [Sparse Feedback Implementation for Sender-Receiver Transportation Linear-Quadratic Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23250)
*Anders Hansson*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文针对稀疏线性二次型（LQ）交通动力控制问题，提出最优反馈增益可分解为两个稀疏矩阵的乘积（即一个稀疏矩阵右乘另一个稀疏矩阵的逆），从而避免直接使用稠密增益矩阵，显著降低计算开销并支持分布式实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统线性二次型调节器（LQR）的最优反馈增益通常是稠密矩阵，直接计算控制信号的计算量过大，难以应用于大规模交通动力系统。

Method: 将最优反馈增益分解为稀疏矩阵右乘另一个稀疏矩阵的逆的形式，在图形适配坐标系下表达问题，从而揭示内在的稀疏结构。

Result: 该分解使得控制信号的计算复杂度远低于直接与稠密增益相乘的方式，并且支持分布式计算实现。

Conclusion: 线性二次型控制问题在图形适配坐标系下并不必然是稠密的，所提公式能够揭示其内在的稀疏性。

Abstract: We study a sparse linear-quadratic problem for transportation dynamics. The goal is to compute the optimal control signal without applying the usually dense optimal feedback gain directly. We show that the optimal feedback gain can be factorized as the product of a sparse matrix and the inverse of another sparse matrix from the right. This factorization enables the control signal to be computed with much less computational effort than direct multiplication by the dense gain. The factorization also enables a distributed implementation. The main message is that linear quadratic control need not appear dense when expressed in graph-adapted coordinates, and that intrinsic sparsity can be revealed under the proposed formulation.

</details>


### [238] [Toward Decarbonization of Chemical Manufacturing: Joint Optimization of Unit Commitment and Microgrid Operations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23400)
*Saba Ghasemi Naraghi,Richard Reed,Tylee Kareck,Paritosh Ramanan,Zheyu Jiang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种集中式优化模型，联合优化电力系统机组组合与电化学蒸汽裂解微电网运行，以实现烯烃生产脱碳。采用两阶段求解方法（Benders分解+热启动）将求解时间降低93.5%。结果表明30%电气化水平可实现最大整体GHG减排，超过该水平则排放和成本上升，可再生能源渗透有助于脱碳瓶颈突破。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 化工过程加热电气化是实现工业脱碳和可持续化工产品制造的关键，但需要联合优化电气化化工过程加热单元与电力系统，以实现两个部门的协同脱碳运作。

Method: 建立混合整数线性规划（MILP）模型，优化德州26个乙烯厂和主电力系统的每小时运营计划。提出两阶段求解方法：第一阶段采用Benders分解与LP松弛子问题解耦微电网与主电力系统；第二阶段以第一阶段最优解作为集中式MILP的热启动点。

Result: 两阶段方法相比直接求解MILP平均降低93.5%求解时间。30%电气化水平实现电力系统和微电网最大整体GHG减排；超过30%后电气化水平越高，整体GHG排放越高，运营成本持续上升（尤其在微电网侧）。可再生能源占比提升有助于突破电气化瓶颈。电气化蒸汽裂解微电网最优运营计划呈现强时空模式。

Conclusion: 30%电气化水平是最优脱碳点，过高电气化反而增加排放与成本；提高电力系统可再生能源占比是支撑深度电气化脱碳的关键；电气化微电网运行呈现显著时空依赖性。

Abstract: The electrification of chemical process heating is essential to industrial decarbonization and sustainable manufacturing of chemical products. Joint optimization of electrified chemical process heating units and electric power systems is needed to achieve decarbonized operation of both sectors. In this work, we introduce a centralized optimization model that identifies the optimal unit commitment of power systems and optimal operation of electrified steam cracking microgrids for sustainable olefins production. A mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) model is developed to optimize the hourly operational plan of 26 ethylene plants and the main power system in Texas. We propose a two-stage solution method to solve the resulting large-scale centralized MILP problem efficiently. In the first stage, we apply Benders decomposition with LP-relaxed subproblems to decouple microgrid operations from the main power system. In the second stage, we use the first-stage optimal solution as a warm starting point for the centralized MILP. This two-stage approach reduces the average solution time by 93.5% compared to direct solution of the MILP. Results show that the largest overall greenhouse gas (GHG) emission reduction for both power systems and microgrids is achieved when the electrification level of steam cracking units is at 30%. Above 30% electrification level, a higher electrification level leads to higher overall GHG emissions and steady increase in operating costs, particularly on the microgrid side. Increasing renewables contributions in the electric power system helps debottleneck the electrification efforts and facilitate holistic decarbonization. We also remark that the optimal operational plan of electrified steam cracking microgrids also exhibit strong spatiotemporal patterns.

</details>


### [239] [Finite difference methods for a continuous-time heterogeneous agent model with recursive utility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23408)
*Yves Achdou,Qing Tang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文针对具有Epstein-Zin效用的连续时间异质代理人模型，提出了两种数值算法（Howard-Newton和Howard-Tarski-Kantorovich），分别处理偏好的晚/早解析情形，证明了算法收敛性及离散化HJB方程解的存在性，并在晚解析情形下给出了连续与离散HJB方程解的先验估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Epstein-Zin递归效用能够分离风险厌恶与跨期替代，但连续时间异质代理人模型中的HJB方程求解存在数值挑战，需要设计高效且收敛性有保障的算法。

Method: 对模型中导出的HJB方程进行离散化，针对晚解析偏好情形提出Howard-Newton算法，针对早解析偏好情形提出Howard-Tarski-Kantorovich算法，并分别证明迭代算法的收敛性。

Result: 证明了所提算法的收敛性，进而得到离散化HJB方程解的存在性；在晚解析情形下，建立了连续HJB方程唯一解与离散化方程解之间的先验误差估计。

Conclusion: 所提出的Howard-Newton和Howard-Tarski-Kantorovich算法能有效求解Epstein-Zin效用下的连续时间异质代理人模型，理论保证了算法的收敛性和数值解的存在性，为后续数值实验和应用提供了理论基础。

Abstract: We propose, analyze and test computational methods for solving a continuous-time heterogenous agent model with Epstein-Zin utility. Such recursive utilities allow the model to disentangle between risk aversion and intertemporal substitution. Having discretized the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equation arising in the model, we propose a Howard-Newton algorithm for the late resolution preference case, and a Howard-Tarski-Kantorovich algorithm for the early resolution preference case. We prove the convergence of the iterative algorithms. We obtain as a consequence the existence of solutions to the discretized HJB equations. In the late resolution case, we supply a priori estimates between the unique solutions of the continuous and discretized HJB equations.

</details>


### [240] [Exponential stability of abstract boundary-coupled positive systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23549)
*Yassine El Gantouh,Mahyar Mahinzaeim*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究了一类抽象边界耦合正系统的适定性和指数稳定性，在一般半群框架下建立了存在性、唯一性和正则性结果，并通过反馈理论和Banach格上的摄动技术给出了简单可验证的测试条件和谱判据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决抽象边界耦合正系统中适定性和指数稳定性的系统性分析问题，为这类系统提供简单可验证的判定条件。

Method: 基于两种互补方法：反馈理论方法和Banach格上豫解正算子的摄动技术，在半群框架下分析边界耦合算子的性质。

Result: 推导出了边界耦合算子上简单可验证的适定性测试条件，以及保证解指数稳定性的谱判据。

Conclusion: 所提出的统一框架能够系统处理抽象动力系统中一大类边界耦合问题，并通过多个算例验证了理论结果的有效性。

Abstract: In this paper, we study the well-posedness and exponential stability of a class of abstract boundary-coupled positive systems. Within a general semigroup framework, we establish well-posedness in terms of existence, uniqueness, and regularity of solutions. More concretely, we derive some simple and readily verifiable tests on the boundary coupling operators for the verification of the well-posedness of the coupled system and, at the same time, provide spectral criteria that guarantee exponential stability of the solutions. The analysis is based on two complementary approaches: the feedback-theoretic method and perturbation techniques for resolvent positive operators on Banach lattices (i.e., Banach spaces equipped with a compatible order structure). This unified framework allows for a systematic treatment of a broad class of boundary couplings in abstract dynamical systems. Several examples are presented to illustrate the applicability of the theoretical results.

</details>


### [241] [A modified Riemannian Levenberg-Marquardt Algorithm for robust or constraint optimization on manifolds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23560)
*Mateusz Baran,Ronny Bergmann*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种鲁棒的黎曼流形Levenberg-Marquardt方法，用于处理包含异常值的应用问题。介绍了块状鲁棒黎曼LM算法的框架，讨论了子问题的多种表述方案，并通过Manopt.jl开源实现展示了该方法在地理回归、Procrustes分析、子空间Procrustes分析和光束法平差等任务中的高效性和鲁棒性，同时与其他非光滑黎曼优化求解器进行了比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的黎曼流形Levenberg-Marquardt方法无法有效处理应用中常见的异常值(outliers)问题，需要一种鲁棒性更强的扩展方法。

Method: 提出了块状鲁棒黎曼Levenberg-Marquardt算法框架，讨论了子问题的多种表述方案，并基于Manopt.jl实现了该方法。

Result: 该方法能够鲁棒地解决地理回归、Procrustes分析、子空间Procrustes分析和光束法平差等问题，且与非光滑黎曼优化求解器相比具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 本文提出的鲁棒黎曼LM方法有效扩展了经典方法的应用范围，能够在存在异常值的场景下保持优化性能，并有开源实现支持。

Abstract: We extend the Levenberg-Marquardt method on Riemannian manifolds to a robust variant that allows to tackle problems from applications where outliers are to be expected. We formally state the framework for a block-wise variant of the Robust Riemannian Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm and discuss how known convergence results can be applied here as well. We further discuss several alternatives for phrasing the sub problem that has to be solved. Finally we illustrate how the accompanying open source implementation in Manopt$.$jl can be used to efficiently solve problems such as geodesic regression, Procrustes analysis, subspace Procrustes analysis and bundle adjustment robustly and compare the Levenberg-Marquardt solver to other solvers for nonsmooth Riemannian optimization.

</details>

### [242] [Towards CSI-Native Foundation Models: A Channel-Adaptive Roadmap for 6G](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20670)
*Chenyu Zhang,Xinchen Lyu,Chenshan Ren,Shuhan Liu,Qimei Cui*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出面向CSI本征的基础模型统一框架，通过尺度感知预训练、物理坐标位置建模和相关性约束注意力机制，在零样本泛化（NMSE降低4 dB以上）、尺度外推（8倍未见天线规模下增益5.4 dB）和推理效率（移动感知加速18.8%）三个维度显著超越现有方法，系统级评估显示仅需7.01%的密集导频开销即可实现-18.64 dB平均NMSE，频谱效率较LMMSE提升36.6%、较WiFo提升15.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无线基础模型将CSI视为通用任务张量而非传播条件信道响应，未能捕捉其时频空几何结构，导致无法实现CSI本征的表示学习。

Method: 提出统一框架，包含三个与信道需求对齐的核心设计：尺度感知异构暴露（scale-aware heterogeneous exposure）、物理时频空坐标建模（physical time-frequency-antenna coordinates）、相关性约束的token交互（correlation-bounded token interaction）。

Result: 零样本泛化NMSE降低超4 dB；8倍未见天线规模外推增益达5.4 dB；移动感知处理加速18.8%；系统级仅需7.01%密集导频开销，NMSE达-18.64 dB，频谱效率较LMMSE提升36.6%、较WiFo提升15.5%。

Conclusion: CSI本征表示学习可支持导频高效的无线接入，为6G系统提供可复用的信道智能基础模型路径。

Abstract: Wireless foundation models offer a path toward reusable channel state information (CSI) intelligence for sixth-generation (6G) systems. However, existing generic-backbone adaptation and CSI pretraining methods often treat CSI as task tensors rather than propagation-conditioned channel responses, thereby failing to capture the intrinsic time-frequency-spatial geometry of wireless environments. This paper presents a channel-adaptive roadmap toward CSI-native foundation models, proposing a unified framework that aligns pretraining, positional modeling, and attention control with three channel requirements: scale-aware heterogeneous exposure, physical time-frequency-antenna coordinates, and correlation-bounded token interaction. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of the proposed framework across three dimensions: zero-shot generalization, reducing NMSE by more than 4 dB across spatial-temporal-frequency tasks; scale extrapolation, yielding up to a 5.4 dB gain under 8 times unseen antenna scaling; and inference efficiency, accelerating mobility-aware processing by up to 18.8%. A system-level evaluation with Sionna SYS further shows that the proposed framework uses only 7.01% of dense-pilot overhead, reaches -18.64 dB average NMSE, and improves average net spectral efficiency by 36.6% over dense LMMSE and 15.5% over WiFo, indicating that CSI-native representation learning can support pilot-efficient radio access.

</details>


### [243] [NeuroShield: A Device-Agnostic Foundation Model for EEG Authentication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20673)
*Matin Fallahi,Patricia Arias-Cabarcos,Thorsten Strufe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出NeuroShield，一种可重用的EEG身份认证基础模型，通过双阶段Transformer架构学习可变通道和可变时长EEG信号的身份判别嵌入，在3个公开数据集上预训练（15,762名被试，28,116个session），在2个未见下游数据集上微调后，等错误率相比SOTA降低0.44-8.06个百分点，并能泛化到训练未见过的更长信号片段和不同通道布局。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有EEG认证模型与采集设置（硬件、通道布局、信号时长）紧密绑定，导致每个新设备或数据集都需要单独开发模型，这种碎片化限制了多数据集学习、阻碍知识迁移、降低模型可重用性。

Method: 采用双阶段Transformer架构（dual-stage transformer architecture），学习可变通道数和可变长度EEG信号的身份判别嵌入表示，通过大规模多数据集预训练实现跨异构采集设置的泛化能力。

Result: 微调后在未见过的下游数据集上等错误率（EER）相比SOTA降低0.44-8.06个百分点；能泛化到训练未见过的更长信号片段；可在预训练未见的通道布局上运行。

Conclusion: NeuroShield是首个可跨异构EEG采集设置重用的身份编码基础模型，开源发布以支持可复现性和社区应用。

Abstract: A central challenge in EEG authentication is that models are typically tied to the acquisition settings in which they are trained. In particular, variations in headset hardware, channel layout, and signal duration create heterogeneous recordings that existing models are not designed to handle, causing each new headset or dataset to be treated as a separate model-development problem. This fragmentation limits multi-dataset learning, hinders knowledge transfer, and reduces model reusability. To address this limitation, we present NeuroShield, a reusable foundation model for EEG authentication that learns identity-discriminative embeddings from variable-channel and variable-length EEG recordings through a dual-stage transformer architecture. We pretrain NeuroShield on three public EEG datasets comprising 15{,}762 subjects and 28{,}116 sessions, and evaluate transfer on two unseen downstream datasets. Our evaluations show that, after fine-tuning, NeuroShield reduces equal error rate by 0.44--8.06 percentage points relative to the state of the art. NeuroShield further generalizes to segments longer than those seen during training and operates across channel layouts not encountered during pretraining. These results establish NeuroShield as a reusable and adaptable EEG identity encoder across heterogeneous recording settings. We release NeuroShield as open source to support reproducibility and community adoption.

</details>


### [244] [Massive Activations Are Architecturally Robust: A Controlled Scratch/Commitment Residual Stream Test](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20743)
*Maruthi Vemula*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Ledger Residuals架构，将残差流分为可写的暂存流（Deliberation）和受保护的解码专用流（Commitment），以检验巨大激活值是否是残差流读写角色冲突的产物。实验表明，即使在专用答案通道中，模型仍会在受保护通道内重建出经典的首token巨大激活值，且更强的稀疏惩罚使其更集中而非消失，说明巨大激活值是功能性而非偶然性产物。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前对Transformer中巨大激活值（massive activations）的来源存在争论：它们究竟是残差流同时承担读写角色所导致的伪像（artifact），还是模型功能上不可或缺的组件。本文旨在直接检验"伪像假说"。

Method: 设计Ledger Residuals架构，将残差流拆分为两个独立通道：Deliberation（可被中间计算自由覆写的暂存空间）和Commitment（受保护的、仅解码时读取的专用通道）。在160M和290M参数规模下训练匹配损失的模型，观察Commitment通道中是否仍出现首token巨大激活。

Result: 1）模型在受保护的Commitment通道中重建了标准Transformer中固定维度、集中于首token的巨大激活值；2）虽然Commitment中重建的巨大激活值幅度小于标准Transformer，但首token上的集中度更高；3）施加更强的稀疏惩罚不仅没有消除该特征，反而使其更加持久和集中。

Conclusion: 巨大激活值在架构上是鲁棒的：无论模型从哪个表示进行解码，它们都会重新出现。这支持了巨大激活值具有功能性而非偶然性的观点。
